_comment: AI provider credentials, managed from the AI page. One entry per service or relay; Dev Setup reads these when pointing a device's AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) at an endpoint. The keys themselves are sealed in the credential vault and never leave the gateway except into the config files Dev Setup writes on machines you own.
_comment_fields: Each entry: id (panel-assigned uuid), name, kind (anthropic | openai | gemini | custom), base_url (empty means the service's default; set it for relays), secret_id (the vault token object holding the key; null until one is entered), is_enabled, models, created_at. The list ships empty; the panel fills it.
